mode: leading real eigenvalue (largest value) of the mean Jacobian diag(mean_{b,t=1..39}(1-h_t^2)) W_hh, calibration T=40 trajectories

spaces.J: edit W so the mean Jacobian eigenvalue moves: dW = diag(1/Dbar) dJ
spaces.W: edit the eigenvalue of W_hh itself

extension_note: J+comp variants (one scalar readout gain refit on calibration t=40), the gradient line search, the zero_edit control and the extra test arm Jc:unit (the principled slow-mode fix) were added after the first 6 candidates of the noise-0.5 model failed preservation on calibration; the test roster had not been touched
selection: argmin calibration MSE@160 over the 9 candidates (3 rules x variants J, W, J+comp) with MSE@40 <= 1.10*base+1e-4; if none feasible, argmin MSE@40; test runs the selected candidate even if it does not beat baseline on calibration
controls: rho=||dW_sel||_F; 20 dense random rank-one; 20 random rank-one on the top-12 rows x top-12 cols of dW_sel; one-step gradient (full rank, top singular component, calibration line search over step scales) of calibration T=160 MSE; zero edit (readout refit only); best-on-calibration dense draw; controls get the same readout refit as the selected candidate
